_comment: One short human name per account, shown beside every position, fill, stop, P/L and trade row in Command Center v3. NAMES ONLY: never an account number and never masked digits (operator 2026-10-23: "just a name, not the account numbers"). Two accounts never share a name; when they would, disambiguate by account type or broker, never by digits. Reader: scripts/lib/account_display.py. Test: tests/test_account_display_labels_20261023.py.
_source: holdings.json config.accounts[*].display_name and account_summaries[*].display_name (2026-10-23), shortened; entries marked proposed await operator confirmation.
